units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 1:1:12">Y. Shek. I, 46ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="U00762"><he>שָׁטַף</he></cite>.
Gen. R. s. 73 ש׳ של גשמים a flood caused by rains (brought the rams from Laban’s fold to Jacob’s); Yalk. ib. 130; a. e.—Trnsf. passion, anger.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 24:2">Lev. R. s. 24</cite>, beg. <he>בזמן שהוא נותן … שיש ש׳ בדינו</he> when he orders execution (punishment), none praise him, for they know that there is passion in his judgment; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 843:14">Yalk. Ps. 843</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:5:2">Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵇ</cite>

senses.gloss: washing, rinsing; כלי ש׳ a vessel which requires only rinsing in order to be restored to Levitical cleanness.

units: Sifré Deut. 166 (ref. to Deut. XVIII, 4) ראשית גז ולא ראשית הש׳ the first of the wool that is cut, but not the first of the wool that comes out by washing.—4) ש׳ של עזים goat-skin made hairless by washing.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:11">Cant. R. to IV, 11</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65">Gen. R. s. 65</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 115:9">Yalk. ib. 115</cite> <he>אין לך … מהש׳ וכ׳</he> there is no smell more offensive than that of washed goat-skins.

senses.gloss: hair that is fallen out, bald pate.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:8">Koh. R. to I, 8</cite> (in enigmatic speech) <he>שִׁיטְפִי מאלל</he> (not <he>שיטפו</he>) my hair is going.
